name: Aurans
description: Valley settlers with strong civic traditions; warm communities, practical craft, and bread-festival culture.
assetTheme: Warm textiles, practical tools, family crests, bread/festival iconography, civic uniforms.

name: Mireborn
description: Wetland lineage; deeply connected to memory and mourning rites; skilled herbalists and memory-keepers.
assetTheme: Reflective glass jewelry, reed houses, mourning veils, memory lanterns, herbal masks.

name: Ashkin
description: Volcanic border people; fierce, honorable, skilled in metalcraft; warriors with deep ritual traditions.
assetTheme: Dark metal armor, red ceramic charms, ember tattoos, basalt architecture.

name: Coastfolk
description: Maritime culture; traders, fishers, and sailors; welcoming to immigrants and prone to festival excess.
assetTheme: Sails, shell ornaments, blue-green dyes, fish markets, rope bridges, shipboard shrines.

name: Highroot Clans
description: Canopy dwellers; ecological stewards with deep knowledge of forest systems and animal behavior.
assetTheme: Layered leaf cloaks, carved wood, animal motifs, vertical village assets.

name: North Archive Houses
description: Snow scholars; keepers of ancestral records and topogenic lore; cold-adapted and deeply analytical.
assetTheme: Pale stone, fur-lined robes, runic ledgers, cold-light lamps, archive vaults.
